**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4222.

The routing lands exactly on the dispatch's shape and the ride-alongs are legitimate: `location`/`geolocation` are the SAME defect in different spellings (object-valued, same terminal input, same `[Object]`-then-string-overwrite pair, same one-line routing to an already-wired widget), not adjacent scope. The two measured non-actions are as valuable as the fix: commit/cancel needed no mirroring (controlled inputs, both hosts commit through the shared InlineEditSaveBar — measured, not assumed), and `coerceToSafeValue` was correctly left alone (an address branch there would fix the display half while leaving the string write intact; the routing makes it unreachable). The pin-construction note deserves the record: the first write-half assertion failed on a MISSING SUB-INPUT query — a different defect's signature — and was replaced with a query-independent helper so the pin fails on the emitted value SHAPE. That is the difference between a pin and a coincidence.

The fall-through sweep is the complete map this switch never had: three defects fixed, three cards filed with verdict classes (destructive-array/container + type-lossy scalars → #4220 with the root cause written out — the hand-rolled switch duplicating `FieldEditWidget` and consulting neither it nor `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES`; the autonumber spelling gap → #4219, the #3355 failure mode; password/secret mask write-back → #4221, severity-split correctly). Controls held on all four boundaries (string terminal input, dialog path, #4215's read state, readonly/computed gating). CI converged 18/2/0, real changeset. Flipping ready + auto-merge. The seat is queueing #4221 (credential-loss severity) and #4219 now; #4220's delegate-vs-route design call gets ruled at its dispatch.
